senses.gloss: sodraṅgīkṛtya (IE 8-3), same as udraṅgīkṛtya; used in respect of a gift land.
s-oddeśa (EI 12, 29), ‘together with the space above the surface of the ground’; epithet of gift land.
s-odraṅga (EI 12, 27, 29), ‘together with the tax called udraṅga’. Udraṅga is = uddhāra, Tamil uttāra, fixed taxes.
